summary: AquaPure is a proposed autonomous underwater cleaning machine designed to reduce pollution in oceans, rivers and lakes. It uses six-stage mesh filtration, automated cleaning mechanisms and Micro-Raman spectroscopy to identify and collect microplastics. Its AI-assisted detection system is also designed to protect aquatic organisms by diverting them away from the filtration process. By combining underwater cleaning technology with potential satellite pollution data, AquaPure aims to help reduce water pollution, protect aquatic ecosystems and support a cleaner, healthier planet.
details:
AquaPure is an innovative underwater cleaning concept designed to tackle plastic waste, microplastics and other pollutants in water bodies.

The machine draws polluted water through its front intake. AI-assisted sensors detect aquatic organisms and direct them towards a separate protective passage. The water then passes through six progressively finer mesh filters, with automated scraper bars transferring collected waste into a storage chamber. Micro-Raman spectroscopy helps identify microplastics, which are collected using a specialised suction and separation system. Additional treatment and water-quality monitoring help assess the processed water before release.

AquaPure aims to reduce underwater pollution, protect aquatic life and support healthier ecosystems. Its future development could combine AI, underwater sensors and satellite observations to identify pollution hotspots and guide cleaning operations.

The proposed technologies include computer vision, underwater cameras, mesh filters, Micro-Raman spectroscopy, sonar and environmental sensors.

Our vision is to make underwater pollution cleaning smarter, safer and more effective through technology.
